title: Adaptive intake gateway for security & compliance asks with region-aware prioritization
creator: Liam Chen
description: Problem: Enterprise customers and channel partners are submitting a high volume of security/compliance asks (DPAs, SOC2/ISO questionnaires, HIPAA attestations, region-specific data residency clauses). Current intake is ad hoc: PMs and Solutions Engineers manually triage, which creates long SLAs, inconsistent prioritization, and lost signal about recurring contract language. Objective: build an adaptive intake gateway that standardizes metadata capture, scores requests by risk/effort/revenue, routes to the right lane (self-serve, legal/pen-test, eng backlog, sales concierge), and produces an evidence starter bundle to accelerate responses.
proposal: Implement a three-part system: (1) Intake UI + upload endpoint: unified form for security asks with required metadata (jurisdiction, data residency, model usage, regulatory regime) and an upload area for vendor questionnaires (XLS/XLSX/PDF). (2) Automated classifier & scoring: lightweight ML + rules engine that extracts clauses and assigns triage score using axes (legal risk, infra impact, data sensitivity, expected revenue). (3) Response automation: generate an initial evidence bundle (SOC2 artifact links, encryption KMS statements, consent docs), suggested SLA tier, and route to target owner or workflow. Provide manual override and feedback loop to retrain classifier. Integrate with Zendesk/Github/Confluence and Console ticketing UI for transparency and handoff.
acceptance_criteria: Intake form collects unified metadata for 95% of incoming enterprise security asks (pilot with 10 customers)
Automated classifier assigns a triage lane with at least 88% precision vs. security team labels in pilot dataset
Evidence starter bundle is produced for at least 70% of uploaded questionnaires, containing links to relevant artifacts (SOC2 report pointer, encryption specs, DPA template)
Average manual triage time reduced by 40% for inbound requests during pilot
Routing integrates with Zendesk (ticket creation + tags) and creates an internal Console work item for engineering/legal when required
Runbook and escalation policy documented and approved by Security & Legal
tasks: PM: finalize data model for intake metadata (jurisdiction, data types, processing activities, model used)
Design: mock intake form and Console flow; create microcopy for admin vs. customer-facing flows
Eng: build upload endpoint, storage, and parsing pipeline for XLS/PDF questionnaires
Eng-ML: prototype clause-extraction model + rules engine and evaluation harness
Security: define triage scoring rubric and provide labeled training set (50 historical requests)
Legal: provide canonical DPA and clause mapping for automated suggestions
Integrations: Zendesk ticket creator, GitHub PR template for engineering actions, Confluence evidence bundle template
SRE: audit logs and KMS access checks for generated bundles
PM: define metrics dashboard (time to first response, triage accuracy, evidence bundle coverage)
QA: end-to-end testing with sample questionnaires and simulated customer uploads
